posts.title: Push to talk
posts.description: Are you one of those crazy people who talks to their computer? I am. I got the little wireless mic and I spend most of my day whispering to my laptop like it owes me money. For a while I was telling everyone how much I loved yapping to a computer full time. Everyone. Unprompted. Anyway. Lakshay , who sat through at least one of my unsolicited microphone TED talks, saw this tweet and thought of me.

posts.title: A little bit of character
posts.description: TL;DR: unicodekit.com is a website for copying characters that I built purely out of spite. Spite is a renewable energy source and I highly recommend it. I use Raycast’s emoji picker pretty much every day. Big fan. But sometimes I need something that isn’t an emoji. An arrow, a chevron, a few box-drawing characters, a solid block pretending to be a terminal cursor. A surprising amount of designing

posts.title: Imperfection
posts.description: If you're reading this, I regret to inform you that I finally published an update to my personal site. I guess I made it. This is a personal site, and I've seen the traffic. Nobody was waiting for this. And I had a blast anyway. Fair warning, this is a long post. I needed something to space out the images.
